blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ أَنَسٍ ﵁ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ قَالَ: يَسِّرُوا وَلَا تُعَسِّرُوا، وَبَشِّرُوا وَلَا تُنَفِّرُوا.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه البخاري، باب ما كان النبي ﷺ يتخولهم بالموعظة....،رقم:٦٩
blocks.tamil_translation: “Deal with people in an easy manner, do not treat them harshly; give good news, do not give news that frightens,” Hazrat Anas (RA) narrates that Rasulullah ﷺ said.

blocks.text: Explanation:- Tell people the good news about the rewards and recompense gained by doing good deeds. They should not be frightened by being told the punishments for their sins to such an extent that they despair of the mercy (rahmah) of Allah Ta'ala and move away from the Deen — this is the meaning.

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ عَبْدِ اللهِ هُوَ إِبْنُ عَمْرٍو ﵄ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ قَالَ: قَفْلَةٌ كَغَزْوَةٍ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه ابو داؤد، باب في فضل القفل في الغزو، رقم: ٢٤٨٧
blocks.tamil_translation: “Returning from the path of Allah is just like going in the path of Allah!” Hazrat Abdullah ibn Amr (RA) narrates that Rasulullah ﷺ said.

blocks.text:
Explanation:- The reward and recompense gained by doing jihad in the path of Allah Ta'ala is also gained after returning from the path of Allah Ta'ala. There must be the firm intention: “As soon as the need for which I returned is fulfilled, or as soon as the call comes to go in the path of Allah Ta'ala, I will immediately set out in the path of Allah Ta'ala.”
(Mazahir-ul-Haq)

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ عَبْدِ اللهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ ﵄ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللهِ ﷺ كَانَ إِذَا قَفََلَ
